title: Migration May Fail During Depeg Conditions
description: The migration function relies on swaps with a 1% slippage tolerance and a `tolerableLoss` check. During significant stablecoin depeg events, these constraints may cause migration to permanently fail, trapping user funds in the old position.
impact: During significant depeg, migration may permanently fail, trapping user funds. Users cannot exit their positions if the protocol needs to migrate to a new strategy.
attackPath: Protocol needs to migrate funds to new strategy
Migration swap fails due to slippage tolerance
codeSnippet: // Migration uses 1% slippage tolerance and tolerableLoss check
recommendation: Add an emergency migration path with configurable slippage for crisis scenarios. Allow admin to increase slippage tolerance during depeg events to enable fund recovery.
